title: Distributional Difference-in-Differences: Aggregation Before or After Quantile Inversion?
abstract: arXiv:2609.27944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Staggered distributional difference-in-differences produces cohort-specific potential-outcome distributions, but applied work typically wants one overall quantile treatment effect. Two natural summaries---averaging cohort quantile treatment effects (QTTs) and mixing cohort distributions before inversion---use the same policy weights yet answer different target-population questions and can disagree even in sign. We derive the exact sharp interval for their gap conditional on cohort quantiles and weights, a globally sharp range-only envelope, and a locally sharp density-tilt representation. We develop joint smooth and mass-point-safe inference and show that neither estimator is uniformly more precise, even when the estimands coincide. In a same-object reconstruction of a public staggered-QTT application, holding data, identification, distributions, and weights fixed while changing only aggregation order reverses reported signs at several q

translated_title: 分布双重差分：在分位数求逆之前还是之后进行聚合？
translated_abstract: 交错采用情形下的分布双重差分会产生各队列特定的潜在结果分布，但应用研究通常希望得到一个总体的分位数处理效应。两种自然的汇总方式——对各队列的分位数处理效应（QTT）取平均，以及先混合各队列分布再求分位数——虽然使用相同的政策权重，却回答了不同的目标人群问题，甚至可能在符号上出现分歧。我们推导了在给定各队列分位数与权重的条件下两者差距的精确尖锐区间、一个全局尖锐的仅基于取值范围的包络，以及一个局部尖锐的密度倾斜表示。我们发展了联合的光滑推断方法及对质量点安全的推断方法，并证明即使在估计对象一致的情况下，也没有哪个估计量具有一致的更高精度。在一项对公开的交错QTT应用的同对象重构研究中，在保持数据、识别、分布和权重不变而仅改变聚合顺序的情况下，多个分位数点上报告的效应符号发生了反转。
tldr: 该论文比较了交错分布双重差分中两种聚合方式（对各队列QTT取平均 vs 先混合分布再求分位数）的差距并给出精确区间与推断方法，发现在实际应用中仅改变聚合顺序就足以使分位数处理效应的符号发生反转。
en_tdlr: This paper compares two aggregation orders in staggered distributional difference-in-differences—averaging cohort QTTs versus inverting mixed distributions—derives sharp bounds for their gap with valid inference, and shows that merely changing the aggregation order can reverse the sign of quantile treatment effects in real applications.
